additional_positive_anchor.role: qualitative counterexample only; not converted into a surface imitation recipe
additional_positive_anchor.observation: Human-positive prose contains short/simple dialogue and short paragraphs, but dialogue is embedded in character-owned action, danger, refusal, inference and interrupted objectives rather than sustained exact-adjacency completion.

inherited_non_rules: short sentences are not inherently AI-like
one-line paragraphs are not inherently AI-like
questions and direct answers are not universally banned
local symptom deletion is not a proven global repair

contrasts.evidence: Phase399 one-sentence-or-less ratio 0.959 versus human-positive Phase370 0.9444.
contrasts.interpretation: Paragraph shortness is too similar across negative and positive spans to serve as the primary causal explanation.
Phase399 is more aggressively fragmented, but the positive span is also highly fragmented; density may amplify visible machinery but is not sufficient as a root cause.

contrasts.evidence: Phase399 deterministic dialogue blocker: 21/43 runs BLOCKED; Phase370: 0/14 runs BLOCKED.
contrasts.interpretation: The strongest measured separator is not shortness but repeated exact-adjacency/shared-agenda dialogue geometry.

contrasts.evidence: Phase399 hard source locks CLEAR while dialogue and immersion gates BLOCK.
contrasts.interpretation: The failure occurs after factual world modeling: the writer preserves facts but serializes agents into one cooperative scene-completion process.

contrasts.evidence: Phase399 appended three editorial suggestion lines after the fiction despite a prose-only contract.
contrasts.interpretation: The one-shot completion can drift from narrator mode into planning/editor mode near the end, consistent with global completion pressure.

evidence_for: Writer saw full private objectives/knowledge for all major agents plus terminal constraints.
Source fidelity was strong while interaction ownership collapsed into shared agendas.
causal_hypothesis_assessment.uncertainty: No controlled visibility-partition experiment has yet been run.

evidence_for: 21 of 43 detected dialogue runs triggered the structural blocker.
Located film-interrogation chains repeatedly use question -> exact answer -> follow-up -> exact answer.
causal_hypothesis_assessment.uncertainty: A changed execution architecture has not yet demonstrated that reducing omniscient/global completion pressure removes the pattern.

evidence_for: A1 was requested as one complete bounded scene from a dense full-world packet.
Output sequentially consumed paperwork, water, film, relationship history, handover and departure-state obligations.
Completion ended with an editor-like three-line optimization note.
causal_hypothesis_assessment.uncertainty: One-shot versus local-horizon generation has not yet been prospectively compared.

evidence_for: Three non-prose editorial directives appeared at the end of the frozen A1.
causal_hypothesis_assessment.uncertainty: This may be a downstream symptom of long one-shot completion rather than an independent cause of mechanical dialogue.

rejected_repairs: force action between every line of dialogue
show dialogue blocker taxonomy to writer
tell writer to imitate Phase370/394 surface features
required_mechanism_change: reduce omniscient visibility available to the prose generator
reduce obligation to finish/cover the entire scene in one completion
preserve independent non-focal agent activity outside a single shared conversational agenda
